# gcmaf.net

> gcmaf.net provides educational information about GcMAF, macrophage biology, research literature, product formulations, storage, professional procurement, and clinical research topics.

## Content guidance
Medical and scientific evidence varies by topic, study design, formulation, and proposed application. Health-related content on this site should be interpreted as informational material rather than as a substitute for professional medical advice. Product and procurement information is intended for qualified healthcare professionals and appropriate institutions where applicable.
